title: DC AND TRANSIENT CIRCUITS
description: Examines and employs techniques for the analysis of linear circuits, including circuit laws and theorems, DC circuit responses, first-order circuit behaviors, operational amplifier characteristics, and applications. Explores fundamental semiconductor devices and device fabrication.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (MTH 251Z, 251HZ, 251 or 251H) and (MTH 252Z, 252HZ, 252 or 252H).
A minimum grade of C is required in MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251, MTH 251H, MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252 and MTH 252H.
meeting_html: W 12pm-1:50pm in DEAR 120 - Dearborn Hall 120 (9/23 to 12/4)
